Chin. and Jpn include the dihydrate. Profile Prasterone is a naturally occurring adrenal androgen that is a pre- cursor of androgens and oestrogens. Prasterone enantate, in a dose of 200 mg every 4 weeks, is given by intramuscular depot injection with estradiol valerate as menopausal HRT (p.2076). Prasterone is also being investigated in adrenal insufficiency and in SLE, and the sodium sulfate has been investigated for the treatment of burns and acute asthma. ◊ General reviews. 1.
